what: The driver asks every slot of a unit at once, so a Body task or a body's Verify can be issued before the unit's own Surface is proved and filed, while a body's universe must hold that surface. The host has to park them by unit, watch for the surface's proof (after a give, at its put, and after memo hits settled with no effect), and give the driver an unreachable capacity so parked tasks hold no slot. A reading of driver.rs end to end was needed to find it.
cost: about an hour of reading and a parking layer in blaze-host that the driver's order would make unnecessary
cause: the driver orders units by dependency but not a unit's bodies after its own surface; Effect::Put carries no unit, and Input::Now has no failure
workaround: blaze-host parks Run and Verify of a body until its unit's surface resolves (host.rs, Host::refresh)
fix: driver.rs: push a unit's Body Run and body Verify only once its Surface slot is Done; add `unit` to Effect::Put and a `TaskFailed` arm to Input::Now
